title: Winnie | Relaxed hooded cardigan, your year-round layer
bodyHtml:
This is the cardigan you'll reach for again and again—whether it's a crisp winter's day or warm afternoons when you need just a touch more. Throw it over a tee, a blouse, or a light jumper for effortless warmth without the bulk, or wear it solo when the weather softens. Versatile, comfortable, and endlessly wearable, it's the one piece that adapts to your day and your climate.

Why you'll love it

  • The perfect layering piece for cooler days—adds warmth without weighing you down
  • Soft and relaxed fit that skims your frame, never clings or bunches
  • All-day comfort from morning to night, whether you're at your desk, running errands, or travelling
  • Works with everything—jeans, trousers, dresses, skirts—open or buttoned
  • Hooded design adds an extra cosy touch for those breezy moments
  • Limited stock from our special Anniversary collection—once it's gone, it's gone
  • Hard to find a cardigan this versatile at this price point

Over 50,000 women have already chosen us, with an average rating of 4.8 out of 5. Your happiness and your trust mean everything to us.
